8. Without going into the merits of the case and considering the facts and circumstances of the case,
it is directed that the Petitioner be released on bail in the aforesaid case subject to stringent terms and conditions as deemed just and proper by the learned court in seisin over the matter with further conditions that:-
i. the Petitioner shall not indulge in any criminal offence while on bail; and ii. the Petitioner shall not tamper with the evidence prosecution evidence in any manner.

etc., around the Biramitrapur Court Complex.
